caption:
Three ways to say no

I used to say yes to everything and resent it by Saturday. Then I started saying I can't this week.

A clear no, said early, tends to cost the other person less than a yes that turns into a cancelled plan.

For whoever says a clear no and keeps it kind.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure that says need you Saturday., in three labeled scenes. The auto-yes: a teal figure says sure, sure! with wide eyes and trembling. The ghost: a brown figure looks down and shuts its eyes without answering, and the blue one narrows its eyes. The clear no: an ink-black figure leans in and says can't this week., and the blue one nods with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of saying no. The last card: Choose friction.
